essenceodyssey.tips.author_gold: Tips from the author are gold!
essenceodyssey.tips.jei_bookmark: Press A on an ingredient to bookmark it.
essenceodyssey.tips.jei_search_mod: Prefix a search with @ to search items by mod.
essenceodyssey.tips.jei_search_tag: Prefix a search with # to search items by tag - but remember to drop the namespace.
essenceodyssey.tips.nuclear_easy: This one is a Chinese joke — sorry, it doesn't survive translation.
essenceodyssey.tips.bee_fbi: Bees have child-protection laws too! Try breeding two baby bees in a breeding chamber and you'll summon the F. Bee I.!
essenceodyssey.tips.2: You can add a spacer to the cogwheel by right-clicking the cogwheel with the andesite_casing — XiaoY
essenceodyssey.tips.3: The Touhou litle maid can do a lot of things for you, like... shake the hand_crank! — XiaoY
essenceodyssey.tips.4: The author's tip is golden. — lvhuana
essenceodyssey.tips.5: To get some rice at the user! — Cobalt Blue
essenceodyssey.tips.6: Who wouldn't want a silly winefox that eats for free? — XiaoY
essenceodyssey.tips.7: I've checked in today. I'm waiting for you~ [This message type is not supported yet. Please view it on mobile QQ.] — cabbage_of_67
essenceodyssey.tips.lilypad: Bonemeal a Starlit Lily Pad to bring it back into bloom.
essenceodyssey.tips.ancient_sapling: Sniffers can sometimes dig up an Ashen Sapling.
essenceodyssey.info.steel_block: JEI only shows the Immersive Engineering steel block, but Mekanism's Block of Steel works too.
essenceodyssey.info.steel_block.detail: When building Immersive Engineering multiblocks, JEI only lists the IE steel block - but Mekanism's Block of Steel works too. Both belong to the same material tag, so they are interchangeable.
essenceodyssey.tips.lock: Items not yet complemented in the Eternal Starlight will have an additional lock icon rendered in the upper left corner of their respective inventory slots.
essenceodyssey.info.aerogel.detail: Formed by placing lava in the Aether.
essenceodyssey.info.aersmog.detail: Formed where water and poison meet.
essenceodyssey.info.mysterious_cube.deta: No tool you have can break the mysterious block in the meteorite — no pick pries it loose, no explosion leaves a mark.
essenceodyssey.info.starcore_light.detai: Right-click a Block of Blazing Starcore with any pickaxe to turn it into a brighter Starcore Light.
essenceodyssey.info.blazing_starcore_blo: Place a Block of Starcore near lava (a fluid source) and it will turn into a Block of Blazing Starcore.
